title: Panel types
intro: A wall-mounted NOC screen needs to show node CPU at a glance. A line chart is too busy. Use a stat panel and a gauge instead.

objectives.text: Add a Stat panel showing node_cpu_usage with unit Percent
Add a Gauge panel showing node_cpu_usage with unit Percent

hints: In the panel editor, change Visualization from "Time series" to "Stat" (and later "Gauge").
Under Standard options → Unit, pick "Percent (0-100)". The query is node_cpu_usage.
solution: Two panels, both with query node_cpu_usage and unit Percent (0-100): one Stat, one Gauge.
debrief: Stat and gauge panels reduce a series to one number (by default the last value). Setting the unit matters: 91 means nothing, 91% means page someone. node-b is running hot, so keep that in mind.
